en-US.author: Vinh Nguyen
en-US.description: An open-source Rust terminal coding agent.
en-US.longDescription:
VT Code is an open-source terminal coding agent that lets you plan, build, and review code using hosted or local AI models.
Use the interactive TUI or vtcode exec to explore a codebase, plan and review changes, and run tools. Choose a model and permission level; VT Code manages context, tool calls, and execution policy, with resumable sessions, sandboxed tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, and Agent Client Protocol (ACP) integration for editors.

en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
0.181.7 - 2026-11-09
Highlights
Features
- Report OSC 7501 status for headless exec runs (4339b3c2)
- Collapse custom themes section by default (26f3661e)
- Read the changelog from Settings → About (fe341dce)
- Move the update check to Settings → About (d57410f0)
- Retry with backoff for background fetches, guard image URLs (128fb488)
- Upgrade pinned gpui-kit from 0.8.1 to 0.9.0 (cba3d44b)
Other Changes
Other
- Cleanup docs (f3f56de7)
Refactors
- Split session-option flows into view/session_options (d7017094)
Tests
- Pin transcript readability contract (efc58bd8)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/vinhnx/vtcode/compare/0.181.6...0.181.7
Desktop app (macOS)
- Download vtcode-desktop-0.181.7-aarch64-apple-darwin.zip (Apple Silicon, macOS 15+), unzip, and drag VT Code.app to Applications.
- One-time macOS security step: this build is ad hoc signed (no Developer ID), so Gatekeeper blocks the first launch. Allow it once in System Settings > Privacy & Security (Open Anyway), then open the app again. See FIRST-LAUNCH.txt inside the zip.
- The bundle includes its matching vtcode CLI helper; open the app anytime with vtcode desktop.
- Verify with vtcode-desktop-0.181.7-aarch64-apple-darwin.zip.sha256 or checksums.txt.

zh-CN.description: 用 Rust 编写的开源终端编程智能体
zh-CN.longDescription:
VT Code 是一个开源终端编程智能体，让你使用托管或本地 AI 模型来规划、构建和审查代码。
通过交互式 TUI 或 vtcode exec 浏览代码库、规划和审查更改并运行工具。选择模型和权限级别后，VT Code 会为你管理上下文、工具调用和执行策略，并提供可恢复的会话、沙盒化工具、模型上下文协议（MCP）支持，以及面向编辑器的智能体客户端协议（ACP）集成。
